rules.question_en: Are you under 18, or 65 or older?
rules.question_es: ¿Tiene usted menos de 18 años, o 65 años o más?
rules.hint_en: The rule stops on the first day of the month you turn 65. Ages 60 to 64 are NOT exempt because of age alone, so keep answering the questions.
rules.hint_es: La regla termina el primer día del mes en que usted cumple 65 años. Las personas de 60 a 64 años NO están exentas solo por su edad, así que siga respondiendo las preguntas.
rules.proofThatHelps_en: The county already has your birth date.
rules.proofThatHelps_es: El condado ya tiene su fecha de nacimiento.
rules.sourceQuote: Individuals who are under 18 or over 64 years of age are not subject to the ABAWD time limit. ABAWD rules may apply to an individual beginning the month after their 18th birthday. An individual is no longer an ABAWD beginning the first day of the month of their 65th birthday.

rules.question_en: Do you live in Alpine, Colusa, Imperial, Merced, Monterey, Plumas or Tulare County?
rules.question_es: ¿Vive usted en el condado de Alpine, Colusa, Imperial, Merced, Monterey, Plumas o Tulare?
rules.hint_en: Santa Clara County is NOT on this list.
rules.hint_es: El condado de Santa Clara NO está en esta lista.
rules.proofThatHelps_en: No proof needed. This waiver ends October 31, 2026.
rules.proofThatHelps_es: No necesita prueba. Esta excepción para estos condados termina el 31 de octubre de 2026.
rules.sourceQuote: The ABAWD Work Requirement is waived from November 1, 2025 through October 31, 2026 for the following counties: Alpine Colusa Imperial Merced Monterey Plumas Tulare

rules.question_en: Is a child under 14 part of your CalFresh household? (Your CalFresh household is the people you buy and cook food with.)
rules.question_es: ¿Hay un niño menor de 14 años en su hogar de CalFresh? (Su hogar de CalFresh son las personas con quienes usted compra y cocina la comida.)
rules.hint_en: The child does not need to get CalFresh. A child you babysit who lives in another household does not count.
rules.hint_es: El niño no necesita recibir CalFresh. Un niño que usted solo cuida (como niñera o niñero) y que vive en otro hogar no cuenta.
rules.proofThatHelps_en: Usually nothing extra. The county uses the child listed on your CalFresh application.
rules.proofThatHelps_es: Por lo general, no necesita nada más. El condado toma en cuenta al niño que aparece en su solicitud de CalFresh.
rules.sourceQuote: Individuals who reside in a CalFresh household with a CalFresh household member under age 14 are exempt from the time limit. The individual is not required to be the parent of the child or responsible for the child. [...] Inclusion of a child under 14 in the same CalFresh household found in the application or recertification documents or verbal statement from the client, unless questionable.

rules.proofThatHelps_en: Telling the county is usually enough.
rules.proofThatHelps_es: Por lo general, basta con decírselo al condado.
rules.sourceQuote: Individuals at any stage of pregnancy are exempt from the time limit. This exemption is effective beginning the month of conception. Verification: Verbal statement from the client, unless questionable. A signed affidavit is not required.

rules.question_en: Does a physical or mental health condition make it hard for you to work 20 hours a week on a regular basis?
rules.question_es: ¿Tiene un problema de salud física o mental que le hace difícil trabajar 20 horas a la semana de forma regular?
rules.proofThatHelps_en: If it is not obvious to the county, a note from a doctor, nurse, therapist, social worker, counselor or other medical or mental health professional helps. The optional CF 887 form can be used. You have the right to get your medical records for free when applying for CalFresh.
rules.proofThatHelps_es: Si no es obvio para el condado, ayuda una nota de un médico, enfermero/a, terapeuta, trabajador/a social, consejero/a u otro profesional de salud médica o mental. Puede usar el formulario opcional CF 887. Usted tiene derecho a recibir sus expedientes médicos gratis cuando solicita CalFresh.
rules.sourceQuote: For ABAWD time limit rules, the physical or mental condition must make an individual unfit to work 20 hours per week on a consistent basis, not unfit to work at all. This includes individuals who might be able to work a few hours per week but cannot work half-time to full-time.

rules.question_en: Have you applied for, or do you get, any disability benefit? (For example SSI, SSDI, state disability, workers' comp, or VA disability at any rating.)
rules.question_es: ¿Ha solicitado, o recibe, algún beneficio por discapacidad? (Por ejemplo SSI, SSDI, discapacidad del estado, compensación de trabajadores (workers' comp) o discapacidad de Asuntos de Veteranos (VA) con cualquier calificación.)
rules.proofThatHelps_en: An award letter or proof that you applied. The county may already see it in its system.
rules.proofThatHelps_es: Una carta que dice que le aprobaron el beneficio, o prueba de que usted lo solicitó. Es posible que el condado ya lo vea en su sistema.
rules.sourceQuote: Individuals who have applied for or are receiving temporary or permanent public or private disability benefits are exempt from the ABAWD time limit. [...] An individual receiving any disability benefit from the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) is unfit to work for the purpose of exempting an individual from the ABAWD time limit.

rules.question_en: Do you take care of someone who cannot care for themselves because of illness or disability?
rules.question_es: ¿Cuida usted a alguien que no puede cuidarse solo/a por una enfermedad o discapacidad?
rules.hint_en: They do not have to live with you.
rules.hint_es: Esa persona no tiene que vivir con usted.
rules.proofThatHelps_en: Tell the county who you care for. Only one adult can use this for the same person.
rules.proofThatHelps_es: Dígale al condado a quién cuida. Solo un adulto puede usar esto para la misma persona.
rules.sourceQuote: Responsible for the care of an incapacitated person (Note: the incapacitated person does not have to be a CalFresh participant or living in the home. This exemption is limited to one adult per incapacitated person. Multiple adults may not claim this exemption for the same incapacitated person.)

rules.question_en: Are you the parent of, or do you take care of, a child under 6? (The child can live somewhere else.)
rules.question_es: ¿Es usted padre o madre de un niño menor de 6 años, o cuida a uno? (El niño puede vivir en otro lugar.)
rules.proofThatHelps_en: Tell the county which child you care for. Only one adult can use this for the same child.
rules.proofThatHelps_es: Dígale al condado qué niño cuida. Solo un adulto puede usar esto para el mismo niño.
rules.sourceQuote: A parent of or responsible for the care of a dependent child under age 6 (Note: the child does not have to be a CalFresh member or living in the home for this work registration exemption. This exemption is limited to one adult per child under age 6. Multiple adults may not claim the exemption for the same child.)

rules.question_en: Are you American Indian or Alaska Native, such as a tribal member, a descendant of a tribal member, or a California Indian?
rules.question_es: ¿Es usted indígena americano/a o nativo/a de Alaska, por ejemplo miembro de una tribu, descendiente de un miembro de una tribu, o indígena de California?
rules.proofThatHelps_en: Telling the county is usually enough. You do not need a tribal card unless the county finds your answer questionable.
rules.proofThatHelps_es: Por lo general, basta con decírselo al condado. No necesita una tarjeta tribal, a menos que el condado tenga dudas sobre su respuesta.
rules.sourceQuote: Self-attestation that a household member is Indian, Urban Indian, or California Indian per the definitions below is sufficient to grant the exemption. Self-attestation may be captured verbally or in writing.

rules.question_en: Have you applied for, or do you get, unemployment benefits (UI)?
rules.question_es: ¿Ha solicitado, o recibe, beneficios de desempleo (UI)?
rules.proofThatHelps_en: Your EDD claim confirmation or payment notice.
rules.proofThatHelps_es: La confirmación de su reclamo del EDD o su aviso de pago.
rules.sourceQuote: f. Has applied for or is receiving unemployment insurance benefits

rules.question_en: Do you regularly go to a drug or alcohol treatment program?
rules.question_es: ¿Va usted con regularidad a un programa de tratamiento para drogas o alcohol?
rules.proofThatHelps_en: A note or attendance record from the program.
rules.proofThatHelps_es: Una nota o un registro de asistencia del programa.
rules.sourceQuote: g. A regular participant in a drug addiction or alcohol treatment and rehabilitation program

rules.question_en: Are you in CalWORKs and following its work rules?
rules.question_es: ¿Está usted en CalWORKs y cumple con sus reglas de trabajo?
rules.proofThatHelps_en: The county can usually see this in your CalWORKs case.
rules.proofThatHelps_es: Por lo general, el condado puede ver esto en su caso de CalWORKs.
rules.sourceQuote: c. Subject to and complying with any work requirement under Title IV of the Social Security Act including CalWORKs programs

rules.question_en: Are you enrolled at least half-time in a school or training program?
rules.question_es: ¿Está usted inscrito/a por lo menos medio tiempo en una escuela o programa de capacitación?
rules.proofThatHelps_en: Your class schedule or enrollment letter. College students must also pass the CalFresh student rule. If you are working toward an associate or bachelor's degree at a community college, CSU or UC, your own statement usually covers that. Other college students should ask the county.
rules.proofThatHelps_es: Su horario de clases o una carta de inscripción. Los estudiantes universitarios también deben cumplir la regla de CalFresh para estudiantes. Si usted estudia para un título asociado (associate) o una licenciatura (bachelor's) en un colegio comunitario, CSU o UC, por lo general basta con lo que usted diga. Otros estudiantes universitarios deben preguntarle al condado.
rules.sourceQuote: i. Enrolled in any recognized school, training program or institution of higher education on at least a half-time basis, whether for credit or as a noncredited enrollee (students enrolled at least half-time in an institution of higher education must meet student eligibility requirements).

rules.question_en: Are you in an Office of Refugee Resettlement training program at least half-time?
rules.question_es: ¿Está usted en un programa de capacitación de la Oficina de Reasentamiento de Refugiados (ORR) por lo menos medio tiempo?
rules.proofThatHelps_en: A letter or statement from the ORR training program.
rules.proofThatHelps_es: Una carta o declaración del programa de capacitación de la ORR.
rules.sourceQuote: Participation in an Office of Refugee Resettlement (ORR) training program for at least half-time exempts an individual from the ABAWD time limit, as long as the person participating in the ORR program is otherwise eligible for CalFresh. [...] Documentary evidence or a written statement from the ORR training program is sufficient verification.

rules.question_en: Do you work at least 30 hours a week, or earn at least $217.50 a week before taxes?
rules.question_es: ¿Trabaja usted por lo menos 30 horas a la semana, o gana por lo menos $217.50 a la semana antes de impuestos?
rules.proofThatHelps_en: Recent pay stubs showing your hours or weekly pay. If you are self-employed, business records.
rules.proofThatHelps_es: Talones de pago recientes que muestren sus horas o su pago semanal. Si trabaja por su cuenta, los registros de su negocio.
rules.sourceQuote: h. Employed or self-employed at least 30 hours per week or receiving weekly earnings at least equal to the federal minimum wage ($7.25 as of the writing of this handbook) multiplied by 30 hours, which is $217.50

rules.question_en: Has any of this happened to you: no stable place to sleep for 6 months or more (or more than once this year); domestic abuse; time in foster care or juvenile justice; or struggling with drugs or alcohol?
rules.question_es: ¿Le ha pasado algo de esto: no tener un lugar estable para dormir por 6 meses o más (o más de una vez este año); abuso doméstico; haber estado en cuidado de crianza (foster care) o en el sistema de justicia juvenil; o tener problemas con drogas o alcohol?
rules.proofThatHelps_en: These are not exemptions on their own. Ask the county to check whether a health condition makes it hard for you to work 20 hours a week. If they can see it is obvious, they must exempt you without asking for proof.
rules.proofThatHelps_es: Estas situaciones no son exenciones por sí solas. Pídale al condado que revise si un problema de salud le hace difícil trabajar 20 horas a la semana. Si el condado puede ver que es obvio, debe darle la exención sin pedirle prueba.
rules.sourceQuote: ABAWDs who meet the definition of chronic homelessness, are struggling with drugs or alcohol, survivors of domestic abuse, or are impacted by the child welfare and juvenile justice systems as defined below, are not automatically exempt from the time limit. These are indicators that an individual may be experiencing circumstances associated with severe mental and physical distress and challenges that may make them obviously unfit to work, but are not exemptions in and of themselves

rules.hint_en: Being a veteran is no longer an exemption by itself. If you get any VA disability benefit, go back and answer yes to the disability benefits question.
rules.hint_es: Ser veterano/a ya no es una exención por sí solo. Si recibe cualquier beneficio por discapacidad de Asuntos de Veteranos (VA), regrese y responda que sí a la pregunta sobre beneficios por discapacidad.
rules.sourceQuote: HR1 removes the temporary exemptions added by the FRA of 2023 for the following populations: • Veterans; • Individuals experiencing homelessness; and • Youth under age 25 who were in foster care on their 18th birthday. Meeting these criteria alone no longer qualifies someone for an exemption from the ABAWD time limit.

rules.question_en: Right now, do you work, volunteer or go to an approved program for at least 20 hours a week on average (80 hours a month)?
rules.question_es: En este momento, ¿trabaja, hace voluntariado o va a un programa aprobado por lo menos 20 horas a la semana en promedio (80 horas al mes)?
rules.proofThatHelps_en: This is NOT an exemption. The rule still applies to you, and you are meeting it. Keep pay stubs, and a signed volunteer form (CF 888) from each place you volunteer. If your average drops below 20 hours a week, report it to the county within 10 days.
rules.proofThatHelps_es: Esto NO es una exención. La regla sí le aplica a usted, y usted la está cumpliendo. Guarde sus talones de pago y un formulario de voluntariado firmado (CF 888) de cada lugar donde hace voluntariado. Si su promedio baja a menos de 20 horas a la semana, repórtelo al condado dentro de 10 días.
rules.sourceQuote: Employment for at least 20 hours per week (or 80 hours averaged monthly) satisfies the work and community engagement requirement. For this provision, 20 hours per week averaged monthly must total at least 80 hours per month.
